info.name: Demo NEAPS V2 with NETCONF command
info.description:
The purpose of this collection is to demo the use of the NEAPS REST APIs for the management of a custom NE audit capability using the **NETCONF** protocol.

The NEAPS management process flow covers all of the NEAPS REST APIs. It has been developed using the _**NTP**_ **NETCONF** NE configuration supported by all PN10x NEs. Note that a default NEAPS is available by the Navigator MC audit application for this same NTP-PN10x NE audit capability.

For details about NEAPS check this Ciena internal page: [NEAPS On-line Help](https://confluence.ciena.com/pages/viewpage.action?spaceKey=MCPRD&title=MCPA+NEAPS+On-line+Help)

The collection is stored in Ciena bitbucket [mcp-docs](https://bitbucket.ciena.com/projects/BP_MCP_SERVICES/repos/mcp-docs/browse/modules/api-guide/assets/attachments) repository.

# Preliminary Setup

Set the Variables used by this collection

- NMC_SERVER - the HTTP address of the Navigator MC server
- NE_NAME - the name of the PN10x NE with a golden NTP config
- NE_FUNCTION - the NE audit capability label demonstrated by this collection
